title: pick it up · hand it over: it goes in the middle

card.wrong: You ~~pick up it~~ along the way.
card.right: You **pick it up** along the way.

why_en: pick up, hand over: it / them go between the verb and up / over (pick it up, hand them over).
why_ru: it — между глаголом и up / over

tokens: Nobody taught me to swim. I
items.answer: Nobody taught me to swim. I picked it up at the lake as a kid.

items.o: My neighbour fills in my tax forms now.
items.post: to her and bake her a cake.

opts: I picked up Italian on holiday.
I picked Italian up on holiday.
I picked up it on holiday.
items.n: With a noun, both: picked up Italian / picked Italian up. With it, only: picked it up.

title: handing over, not handling

card.wrong: Companies are ~~handling~~ that work over to AI.
card.right: Companies are **handing** that work over to AI.

why_en: hand sth over = give it to someone else to do · handle sth = deal with it yourself.
why_ru: hand over — передать; handle — справиться самому

items.o: Angry customers? I'm useless with them.
items.n: handing (hand over), not handling · them in the middle.

items.o: My colleague is brilliant with angry customers.
items.n: handle = deal with it yourself · she handles (-s).

title: I've never used it since
why_en: I've never used it since / I haven't used it since: have + used.
why_ru: с тех пор ни разу: I've never used it since

items.pre: I did a pottery course in 2019, and
My husband bought an electric guitar for his 40th.
items.n: or: he's never played it since

title: a, the: the small words

card.wrong: It was ‸ complete waste of time.
card.right: It was **a** complete waste of time.

card.wrong: I learned it ~~in a~~ hard way.

why_en: a waste of time, a learning curve · the hard way: always the.
why_ru: a waste of time — нужен a; the hard way — всегда the

items.answer: That two-hour webinar on productivity? A complete waste of time.

tokens: My first month with a puppy: I learned
items.answer: My first month with a puppy: I learned the hard way that puppies eat shoes.

title: back in my day
why_en: back in my day / in our day: no -s (but: in my student days, in my younger days).

items.o: — My son orders everything online, even bread.
items.post: , you went to the shop and talked to people!
items.n: day, no -s · or: back in my youth

items.o: — Kids get phones at nine now.
items.post: , there was one phone in the hall and everyone could hear you.
items.n: day, no -s · or: in our time
